name: Keldran
summary: North of the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar, Keldran works to open a path to peace with the Alliance. He directs secret strikes against demonic remnants, hoping to show that the modern Horde has left the Burning Legion behind.

sections.title: A Diplomatic Crusade
sections.body:
Keldran works from Orgrimmar’s red rock terraces while Thrall governs from the Valley of Wisdom. The Alliance still sees orcs as bloodthirsty puppets of demonic masters, a reputation forged in the first wars. Keldran believes Thrall has grown weary of endless conflict.

Yet peace talks cannot begin while demon-worshiping cults endure in Kalimdor. Without the Warchief’s formal sanction, Keldran takes the initiative and directs trusted agents toward distant threats. He hopes to erase the demonic stain and clear the way for diplomacy.

sections.title: The War in Desolace
sections.body: In Desolace, Keldran has sent Takata Steelblade and Maurin Bonesplitter to lead operations against demonic infestations. Their chief target is the Burning Blade cult. Keldran hopes to eradicate its practitioners and bring proof back to Orgrimmar. He means to show the Alliance that the new Horde stands against the Legion alongside humans and night elves.

faq.answer: North of the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar, Keldran organizes efforts against demonic influence to open a path toward diplomacy with the Alliance.

faq.q: Why does Keldran care about relations with the Alliance?
faq.answer: Keldran believes Thrall is growing weary of constant war with the Alliance. Peace talks cannot begin while the Alliance thinks the Horde remains allied with the Burning Legion.

faq.q: Is Keldran acting under Thrall's official orders?
faq.answer: No. Keldran acts without formal authorization from Warchief Thrall. He seeks to clear the Horde’s name and prepare the way for peace.

faq.q: What is Keldran doing in Desolace?
faq.answer: Keldran sent Takata Steelblade and Maurin Bonesplitter to Desolace to fight demonic forces. Their chief target is the Burning Blade cultists.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you see Keldran's effort to cast off its demonic reputation and secure lasting peace on Kalimdor.
As a warlock, you see Keldran wage a covert war against the Burning Blade. The Horde’s leadership wants to distance itself from uncontrolled demonic corruption.
